title: Amazing Ocean Animals
description: Learn about some of the most amazing animals in the sea.
instructions: Read about ocean animals. Then choose the right answer.

paragraphs.text: 🐋 The ocean is home to some of the most amazing animals in the world. It covers more than seventy percent of the Earth, and scientists have not explored most of it yet.
The blue whale is the biggest animal that has ever lived. It is longer than three buses, and its heart is as big as a small car. Although it is so big, it eats only tiny animals called krill.
Dolphins are very clever. They live in groups, and they talk to each other with clicks and whistles. Sometimes dolphins help people who are swimming in the sea.
🐙 The octopus has eight arms and three hearts. It can change its colour in a second, so it is hard to see when it hides on the rocks. If an enemy comes, it shoots out black ink and escapes.

Sea turtles travel thousands of kilometres across the ocean. A mother turtle always comes back to the beach where she was born to lay her eggs. Sadly, many turtles are in danger because they eat plastic bags, which look like jellyfish.
Some animals live deep in the ocean, where it is very dark. The anglerfish has a little light on its head. Small fish swim towards the light, and then the anglerfish catches them.
We can help ocean animals. We should not throw rubbish into the sea, and we should use fewer plastic bags. If we take care of the ocean, these amazing animals will live safely for many years.
